_comment: Supply-chain lock of files/mcp-servers.json (WS-AI-009). npm servers: exact version and the sha512 npm publishes (dist.integrity); the full tree is in files/home/.local/lib/ws-npm/<npm>/package-lock.json and must agree (tests/supply-chain.sh). local: executables built on each machine, pinned by sha256 on first registration (trust on first use) in ~/.local/share/ws-kit/mcp-trust.tsv. remote: HTTP servers, pinned by URL. optIn: not registered unless install.sh --mcp-opt-in <name>.

azure.prereleaseReason: No stable 4.x yet (checked 2026-11-25: npm has 4.0.0-beta.1 to beta.10; the only stable, 3.0.0 of 2026-10-12, is an older line than the 4.0 betas the ask rules in settings.json were written against, and moving back would drop the 4.0 fixes). Pinned at the newest beta past the 7-day cool-down. Move to the first stable 4.x when it ships (bash .github/scripts/bump-pinned.sh azure-mcp <version>).

chrome-devtools.optInReason: Needs a Chrome reachable from WSL (Google Chrome installed in WSL, or a Windows Chrome with a separate profile and a remote-debugging port, which needs mirrored networking).
